results.title: Crypto exchange loses $120 million in hot wallet hack
results.content: A major cryptocurrency exchange said on Tuesday that attackers drained about $120 million from one of its hot wallets. Withdrawals were paused while the company investigates.

results.title: EU regulators publish final MiCA guidance on stablecoins
results.content: European regulators released final technical standards for stablecoin issuers under MiCA.
